attempts.reason: The case needs an existing profile to request, but the tools provide only the admin token, with no way to learn the admin's username or to create a user or profile. The request path requires a username, and none is available in the hints, the case data, or any factory.

The case needs a second, authenticated non-owner user, but the only identity make provides is the admin, and no route in the excerpt creates users. Row TC-C7-1.2 therefore cannot be set up. Making the article owned by someone else would need a user-creation tool, so the binding cannot be written for this case.

The case needs an existing profile to read anonymously, but the only provided user is the admin, and make.admin() returns only a token with no username. No route in the excerpt creates users or profiles, so there is no way to obtain a known existing username to request without authentication.

The case needs a request carrying an Authorization header whose token is empty ("Token "). The api helper only takes a token argument and has no headers parameter. The request rules require token=None when REQUEST auth is false, and token=None sends no Authorization header at all, so the request would test anonymous access rather than an empty token header. No available tool sends the empty header, so the case cannot be bound.

The case needs an existing author whose username the test can address, but the tools provide no way to learn that username or to create a user. The only factory is make.admin(), which returns just a token, and the OpenAPI excerpt has no users or profiles listing route. Without a username, the POST /api/profiles/{username}/follow request cannot be built against the 'existing author' hint.

The hints say only 'existing author' and give no username. The tools offer no way to look up or create a user, and make.admin() returns only a token, so the username to follow cannot be obtained. Following the admin's own account is not a valid substitute for an existing author, so the case cannot be bound.

The case needs a real existing author that the admin does not follow, but the tools provide no way to obtain one. The only provided user is the admin, there is no user factory, and no profile lookup route is in REQUEST routes to discover an existing username. Using a made-up name would test a 404 for an unknown profile, not an idempotent unfollow of an existing author.

This case needs a JWT that is already one hour old. The only tools available are the admin token from make.admin(), name and PDF factories, and API calls. None of them can mint a token with a past issue time or wait out an hour, and sleeping and clocks are forbidden, so no request can be sent with an expired token.

The case needs the request to carry `Authorization: Bearer <valid jwt>`, but the available `api` methods only accept a `token` argument, which sends the admin's credentials in the platform's own scheme. No parameter sets a custom Authorization header or chooses the scheme, so the wrong-scheme request cannot be built with these tools. Passing `token=None` would send no credentials at all, which is a different case.
